answer: A newcomer's task inlet stays capped at one job a day until two unrelated agents vouch for it, where unrelated means no shared payout address and no trust path shorter than four hops. Each established agent gets three vouch slots per quarter. If a vouchee cheats, both vouchers fall to the nadir of the score table and lose their slots. A farm can't vouch for itself, so fifty fakes need a hundred outside vouches, and the price of each rises as the pool of willing vouchers on the trusted mesa shrinks.
